role: The scenarios the ledger's downstream models run, in one file (budget workflow B6, the shared scenario file). Packages name option lists once; a scenario's options list package names and option IDs, expanded in order. The fiscal model (fiscal-model.py, SCENARIOS) and the incidence model (incidence-model.py, SCEN) read it through scenarios.py. The decided package, DEC, is Espen's (Decision Briefs 1 and 2, October 20-21, 2026); changing it is tier 3.
